flows.name: A customer-service agent asks a person before a high-value decision (GetVocal)
flows.summary: GetVocal's home page, in its example: a customer asks to return a home cinema kit; the agent flags it for human approval, an operator validates, the agent completes; every decision is grounded in the business's rules and audited in the Control Tower. The customer names and outcomes are GetVocal's own.

steps.what: Its rules, policies and escalation thresholds are modelled in ContextGraphOS; every agent decision is grounded in it.
Holds the conversation with the customer and handles the request.
Flags a high-value return for human approval ("I'll just check with my human supervisor").
Validates or instructs from the Agent Control Tower, which monitors live, enforces policy, can override any agent and audits every decision.
Completes the task; the correction or approval becomes a training signal (the Human-AI Flywheel).
